{{Quote|And we... we made... what did we ''call'' it? Oh yes... yes...! It's all there... it all comes back. We called it... war.|Ship|<ref name="MSW38" />}}
An '''extra-galactic war''' was fought in a distant galaxy by [[Ship (sentient spacecraft)|Ship's]] [[Unidentified species (mecho-organic builders)|species]]. They built giant [[mecho-organic vessel]]s to fight each other, until only Ship remained. Ship then returned home, only to discover that its enemies had released a [[plague bomb]], killing all sentient life and contaminating the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Fearing the plague, Ship fled its galaxy and drifted in the [[Intergalactic Void|intergalactic void]].
